tagline: Games, raids and good vibes with the Spooners. Live on Twitch and YouTube.

schedule.notes: Boss Fight, Hive Lord, Horde and Knight in the PTT voice channel

patreon.blurb: Patrons keep the streams, raids and the Spooners game going. Every tier gets the Supporter role in the Discord.

tiers.name: Spoon
tiers.perks: Supporter role in Discord, your name in the stream credits

tiers.name: Big Spoon
tiers.perks: Everything in Spoon, plus early Spooners skins and a say in the game lineup

vote.question: What should we play next?
vote.how: Vote in the Discord poll or type !vote in chat.

raids.how: Join the PTT voice channel in the Discord, then type in the raid chat to spawn your Spooner. Use !shoot, !slash, !grenade and !stim to fight. Everyone who helps gets XP.

modes.name: Boss Fight
modes.text: Three rotating bosses that level up. !attack, !shield, !heal.

modes.name: Hive Lord
modes.text: A giant armoured worm tunnels under the sand. !shoot, !grenade, !stim.

modes.name: Horde Mode
modes.text: Robot waves grow every round. If everyone goes down, the horde wins.

modes.name: Knight Fight
modes.text: Duel the knight with !slash, or call someone out with !duel @name.

spooners.blurb: Your Spooner is the avatar you already use on stream. Soon it gets a home on the web: make it yours, gear it up and raid with the Alliance online.

features.name: Character creator
features.text: Pick a skin, colour and hat. Your look follows you to stream, Discord raids and the hub.

features.name: Spoon shop
features.text: Spend the XP you earn chatting and raiding on skins, hats and moves.

features.name: Raids & Horde online
features.text: Fight bosses together from the website or right inside Discord.

map.blurb: Spooners are everywhere. Add yourself to the map: we only save your continent, country and state.

support.name: Patreon
support.perk: Supporter role, early Spooners skins, behind-the-scenes posts

support.name: Twitch sub
support.perk: Sub emotes, no ads, sub badge and the Supporter perks in chat

support.name: YouTube membership
support.perk: Member badge and emotes in YouTube chat
